responsibility: Defines the Modula-2 interface to the main `m2.flex` scanner used by the gm2 front end. It exports source open/close, token retrieval, current line and column reporting, GCC `location_t` retrieval for the current token, total-line counting, and lexer error reporting, making it the scanner contract consumed by the buffered lexer layer and parser passes for source-position-aware tokenization of Modula-2 input.
